name: Kynnefjälls natur - Vaktarekullen
description: Kynnefjälls natur to Vaktarekullen. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: KynnefjällsNatur: Stage-start lodging/business. WST lists lodging, drinking water and toilet. KynnefjällsNatur lists breakfast, packed lunch and dinner services, but restaurant appears mainly for booked guests/groups.
Naturlig källa vid Vaktarekullen: Spring near Vaktarekullen cabin. WST says water is tested regularly but should be boiled before use.
notes: Current official title/API/geometry and Munkedal support Kynnefjälls natur to Vaktarekullen. WST English body text still says starts in Lunden, Naturkartan slug/GPX filename and older route-app/blog sources retain Lunden - Vaktarekullen.
WST lists 16 km, Naturkartan 16.4 km and current official geometry computes 16.376 km; older sources list 14-15 km or 10.8 km.
WST/Naturkartan start at [58.618192, 11.690120], while OSM Stage 18/19 shared point is [58.6185277, 11.6892989] about 60.4 m away and KynnefjällsNatur facility geocode is nearby.
WST and OSM coordinates for Säveleken shelter differ by about 120 m.
WST says Vaktarekullen has a regularly tested spring but water should be boiled; a 2022 Wikiloc hiker reported no water at the cottage and used lake water.
Bredmossen, Lunden/Vaktarestugan, Stora Holmevatten and Kasebo are important Kynnefjäll context/access/detour records but are off current Stage 19 main geometry.

facilities.name: KynnefjällsNatur
facilities.description: Stage-start lodging/business. WST lists lodging, drinking water and toilet. KynnefjällsNatur lists breakfast, packed lunch and dinner services, but restaurant appears mainly for booked guests/groups. Water/toilet/food may depend on staffed/customer/booking access. Do not mark as always-open public service without verification.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Äntervattnet
facilities.description: Official shelter at Äntervattnet. WST lists shelter, toilet and fireplace; KynnefjällsNatur confirms overnight wind shelter, toilet and barbecue. OSM says capacity 3-4 and bin=no. Fire use subject to Kynnefjäll designated-fireplace rules and live fire bans. No reliable waste disposal; OSM says bin=no.

facilities.name: Påsholk Äntervattnet
facilities.description: Bag holder for visitors collecting litter. This is not a waste bin or disposal point. Do not model as public trash disposal.

facilities.name: Vindskydd Säveleken
facilities.description: Official shelter at Lake Säveleken. OSM confirms shelter and firepit but says limited tent space. Coordinate sources differ materially. WST and OSM differ by about 120 m; Check before final import. No confirmed toilet.

facilities.name: Vaktarekullen overnight cabin
facilities.description: End-stage open overnight cabin. WST/Västkuststiftelsen report 12 beds, stove, firewood and dry toilet. Västkuststiftelsen says no booking, free/shared, one night at a time. Expect sharing; no booking. Fires should use cabin stove or prepared fire sites, not ground fires.

facilities.name: Vaktarekullen firepit/viewpoint
facilities.description: Designated fire/viewpoint area near Vaktarekullen cabin. Fire in Kynnefjäll reserve only at designated places and subject to live fire bans.

facilities.name: Naturlig källa vid Vaktarekullen
facilities.description: Spring near Vaktarekullen cabin. WST says water is tested regularly but should be boiled before use. Not potable as-is; boil/treat. A 2022 Wikiloc report said no water at the cottage and used lake water, so Check/carry backup.

facilities.name: Kasebo
facilities.description: Important access/connector for Kynnefjäll and Vaktarekullen. WST lists parking, dry toilet and information boards. OSM toilet says drinking_water=no. About 1.5 km straight-line from Vaktarekullen and likely 2-3 km practical walk. Two Kasebo locations can mislead GPS; correct GPS address reported as Krokstads Borgen 13.
